app_desc: Turn your phone into a smart traffic counter. Piyuo Counter uses on-device AI to count people and vehicles while protecting privacy. Instead of storing videos, it creates easy-to-understand traffic summaries, including pass-bys, entries, exits, occupancy, and average stay time. Videos, images, and audio never leave your device.
index_1_desc: View foot traffic counts for any time period.
index_2: More than just a people counter.
index_2_desc: Track pass-bys, entries, exits, occupancy, and stay time to understand how people move through your location. Clear traffic insights help you measure performance and make better business decisions.
index_3_desc: Draw a custom counting area anywhere in the camera view, such as a store entrance, sidewalk, doorway, or checkout. Measure traffic exactly where you want.
index_4: Set it up once. Keep counting automatically.
index_4_desc: Piyuo Counter is designed for continuous operation over days or weeks. Place your phone where you want to measure traffic, start counting, and let it automatically collect summarized traffic data. No daily operation is needed.
index_desktop2_desc: The desktop version supports live camera streams. Instead of using a webcam, connect your existing security camera and enter its stream URL. Piyuo Counter supports RTSP cameras for a flexible setup.
index_desktop_title: Run on the device you already have.
index_desktop_desc: Piyuo Counter supports iPhone, Android, macOS, and Windows. Use your phone's camera or your computer's webcam to turn your device into a smart traffic counter.
index_video_desc: Piyuo Counter counts people and vehicles in real time, then creates a simple traffic summary every 5 minutes. These summaries are synced every hour, giving you fresh traffic insights without continuous uploads.
